# Knowledge bases (partitions)

14 calls. Every request needs the `Authorization` header: see [the overview](../index.md).

## `partitions.list`

```http
GET /partitions
```

Every partition.

**Who can call it:** Tenant admins only, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=GET%20%2Fpartitions).

**Response:** [`Partition`](../types/partition.md)`[]` (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X GET "https://api.maitento.com/partitions" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH"
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const partitions = await mt.partitions.list();
```
```python title="Python"
mt.partitions.list()
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `partitions.create`

```http
PUT /partitions
```

Creates a partition (a temporary one deletes its files after `fileLifetimeHours`).

**Who can call it:** Tenant admins only, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Fpartitions).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `partitionId` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`PartitionCreateRequest`](../types/partition-create-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | The partition's name. |
| `isTemporary` | `boolean` |  | Create a temporary partition: its files are never indexed and are removed once they are `fileLifetimeHours` old. Cannot be changed once the partition exists. |
| `fileLifetimeHours` | `integer \| null` |  | A temporary partition's file lifetime, in hours; null is 24. Refused on an ordinary partition. |

**Response:** [`Partition`](../types/partition.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/partitions" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"..."}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const partition = await mt.partitions.create({ name: "handbooks" });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.partitions.create("handbook")
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `partitions.delete`

## `partitions.setEmbeddingCredentialStack`

```http
PUT /partitions/by-id/{id}/embedding-credential-stack
```

Sets the credential stack a partition embeds with (Tenant.Admin), or clears it with `null`. Its own embedding keys are tried first, then the stack's, in place of the tenant's model keys and default stack; Maitento's key is never used.

**Who can call it:** Tenant admins only, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Fpartitions%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fembedding-credential-stack).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`PartitionEmbeddingCredentialStackRequest`](../types/partition-embedding-credential-stack-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credentialStackId` | `uuid \| null` |  | The id of one of your credential stacks, or null to clear. |

**Response:** [`Partition`](../types/partition.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/partitions/by-id/<id>/embedding-credential-stack" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"credentialStackId":"..."}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.partitions.setEmbeddingCredentialStack("d6e5f4a3-b2c1-4d0e-9f8a-7b6c5d4e3f2a", "5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f"); // null clears it
```
```python title="Python"
mt.partitions.set_embedding_credential_stack("4b5c6d7e-8f9a-4b0c-9d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e", "5a6b7c8d-9e0f-4a1b-8c2d-e3f4a5b6c7d8")
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `partitions.setEmbeddingCredentials`

```http
PUT /partitions/by-id/{id}/embedding-credentials
```

Sets the keys a partition embeds with (Tenant.Admin).

**Who can call it:** Tenant admins only, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Fpartitions%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fembedding-credentials).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`PartitionEmbeddingCredentialsRequest`](../types/partition-embedding-credentials-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credentials` | [`PartitionEmbeddingCredentialInput`](../types/partition-embedding-credential.md#in-a-request)`[]` | yes | The keys, in failover order. May be empty only with `allowMaitentoFallback` true, which means "no key of my own, use Maitento's". To remove the keys, use `DELETE /partitions/by-id/{id}/embedding-credentials`. |
| `allowMaitentoFallback` | `boolean` |  | Consent to fall back to Maitento's key when every key above has failed. Defaults to false: once your own keys are exhausted, the embedding fails. |

**Response:** [`Partition`](../types/partition.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/partitions/by-id/<id>/embedding-credentials" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"credentials":[]}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.partitions.setEmbeddingCredentials("d6e5f4a3-b2c1-4d0e-9f8a-7b6c5d4e3f2a", { credentials, allowMaitentoFallback: false });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.partitions.set_embedding_credentials("4b5c6d7e-8f9a-4b0c-9d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e", credentials=[{"provider": "OpenAi", "apiKey": os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]}], allow_maitento_fallback=False)
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `partitions.changeEmbeddingProfile`

```http
PUT /partitions/by-id/{id}/embedding-profile
```

Changes a partition's embedding profile (may re-index every file: never retried).

**Who can call it:** Tenant admins only, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Fpartitions%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fembedding-profile).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`PartitionEmbeddingProfileRequest`](../types/partition-embedding-profile-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | [`PartitionEmbeddingProfileInput`](../types/partition-embedding-profile.md#in-a-request) | yes | The profile to index the partition with. |
| `credentials` | [`PartitionEmbeddingCredentialInput`](../types/partition-embedding-credential.md#in-a-request)`[]` | yes | Your keys for the profile's provider, in failover order. May be empty only with `allowMaitentoFallback` true, which means "no key of my own, use Maitento's", or with a `credentialStackId`. |
| `allowMaitentoFallback` | `boolean` |  | Consent to fall back to Maitento's key for this provider when your keys are exhausted. |
| `credentialStackId` | `uuid \| null` |  | The id of one of your credential stacks for the partition to embed with, set in the same change, so the profile and the stack that serves it always match. With a stack, `credentials` may be empty, and Maitento's key is never used. Null leaves the partition's stack as it is; clear one with `PUT /partitions/by-id/{id}/embedding-credential-stack`. |
| `allowReindex` | `boolean` |  | Whether this request may start a re-index. Defaults to true. Send false when you only mean to update the keys: if the profile would need a different index, the request is refused with `api:embeddings:reindex-not-permitted` and nothing changes. When the profile needs the same index, a failed re-index is resumed if the keys or consent changed, or, when this is true, even if they did not (a deliberate retry). |

**Response:** [`Partition`](../types/partition.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/partitions/by-id/<id>/embedding-profile" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"profile":{"model":"..."},"credentials":[]}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.partitions.changeEmbeddingProfile("d6e5f4a3-b2c1-4d0e-9f8a-7b6c5d4e3f2a", { profile, credentials, allowMaitentoFallback: false, allowReindex: true });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.partitions.change_embedding_profile("4b5c6d7e-8f9a-4b0c-9d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e", profile={"provider": "OpenAi", "model": "text-embedding-3-large"}, allow_reindex=True)
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `partitions.probeEmbeddingProfile`

```http
POST /partitions/embedding-profile/probe
```

Tries an embedding profile and keys without saving them (a failed probe is still a 200).

**Who can call it:** Tenant admins only, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=POST%20%2Fpartitions%2Fembedding-profile%2Fprobe).

**Request body:** [`PartitionEmbeddingProbeRequest`](../types/partition-embedding-probe-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | [`PartitionEmbeddingProfileInput`](../types/partition-embedding-profile.md#in-a-request) | yes | The profile to test, validated exactly as a profile change is (a custom model must state its width). |
| `credentials` | [`PartitionEmbeddingCredentialInput`](../types/partition-embedding-credential.md#in-a-request)`[]` |  | The keys to test with, in priority order. At least one; the same rules apply as when setting a partition's keys. |

**Response:** [`PartitionEmbeddingProbeResult`](../types/partition-embedding-probe-result.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X POST "https://api.maitento.com/partitions/embedding-profile/probe" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"profile":{"model":"..."}}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const probe = await mt.partitions.probeEmbeddingProfile({ profile, credentials });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.partitions.probe_embedding_profile(profile={"provider": "OpenAi", "model": "text-embedding-3-large"})
```

## `partitions.embeddingStatus`

```http
PUT /partitions/embedding-status
```

The embedding status of many partitions (sent in batches of 500 ids).

**Who can call it:** Tenant admins only, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Fpartitions%2Fembedding-status).

**Request body:** [`PartitionEmbeddingStatusRequest`](../types/partition-embedding-status-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `partitionIds` | `uuid[]` | yes | The partitions to report on. Unknown ids (or another tenant's) are omitted from the response. |

**Response:** [`PartitionEmbeddingStatus`](../types/partition-embedding-status.md)`[]` (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/partitions/embedding-status" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

```
